doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Ma Rainey's show
summary: Billie describes Ma Rainey's carnival-minstrel show with comedians and chorus girls, which she saw in Florida.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, I wish I could have heard more of Bessie, I'm sorry I didn't hear Ma Rainey. Yeah. What kind of show did Ma Rainey travel with, do you remember when you'd hear what kind of a show it was, or what she did?
I forgot what, I forgot what, just but a vaudeville I saw like it, you know. Some kind of vaudeville. A vaudeville, yeah.
I didn't know if it was more like a carnival or minstrel shows or what kind of show she might have traveled with.

It was more carnival like, to my idea, now, it was more like a minister, see, because she had many chorus, chorus, girl dancing, more of a minister, like, you know. A lot of jokes and stuff. Yeah, two comedians, you know, like that, two comedians and a straight man with them, you see, and then the chorus girls, and she sang, you know, blues, you know.
Like that. Did you ever get to New Orleans when you were over here, or did you here in Florida and around the country?
Florida, that's where I first met her, Florida.
